decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range builds directly on the firm's core footwear and materials know-how, so in-house R&D can keep refining it, and the missing archive data after 2019 says nothing about its market performance.

ESD occupational shoes are a standard, persistent requirement in industrial workplaces and sit squarely within the firm's existing technical competence, making the product easy to maintain and improve.

A safety shoe series close to the established offer benefits from the firm's absorptive capacity, though named series in footwear are refreshed or replaced more often, which gives a moderate chance of withdrawal.
